name: entity-create
description: Declarative entity-creation buttons. Each consuming blueprint declares new_entity_buttons[] in its manifest; installer materializes either a nav_buttons action (kind: nav_buttons) or an injected AccentButton block into a target file (kind: hub). The EntityCreate CustomJS class executes prompts → frontmatter hydration → file create → open. Replaces 7 hand-authored New<X>Button classes across meetings/people/project/scratch/finance. v0.2.0 MINOR (v0.47.0): render() consumes customJS.Icons.resolve for kebab-name → SVG translation (fixes BUG-1 from headspace Phase 3); JSON-schema tightens body_template + extra_files[].body_template to basename-only (fixes BUG-3/4 path-resolution mismatch). v0.2.1 PATCH (v0.48.0 S7): FLN-c — plusIcon SVG 16x16 → 15x15 for size consistency with Tier 1 vendored icons in icons mechanism (all 21 Tier 1 SVGs are 15x15). Behavior-preserving 1px change in the fallback path (when Icons.resolve returns null). v0.3.2 PATCH (v0.50.4): _createExtra now ensures the parent dir of xPath when filename_pattern itself embeds a subfolder (e.g. "wiki/Wiki.md"). Previously only xFolder (= folder + optional subfolder field) was ensured; vault.create against a missing parent silently left an empty file. Forward-defense for filename_pattern with embedded slashes; canonical form remains the subfolder field. v0.4.0 MINOR (v0.68.0): new_entity_buttons[].render_in is now optional in both the JSON schema and the installer's resolveEntityCreateEntry validator. Entries with no render_in are registry-only — the materializer's injection loop short-circuits cleanly, EntityCreate.create() dispatch still works (registry stays populated). Enables blueprints to own button rendering when a custom flex-row layout is required (scratch v0.5.0 uses this to host both '+ New Scratch' and 'Hub' inside one ScratchDayActions-drawn row). v0.5.0 MINOR (v0.102.0 S1): two additive capabilities for project-workspace cycle, both backward-compatible (calls without these fields behave exactly as v0.4.0). (a) presetPrompts — render(dv, { instance, presetPrompts: { <key>: <value> } }) plumbs through onClick to create(); the prompt loop short-circuits on each matching key (bypasses derive + UI + validation). Preset values are trusted (helper code's responsibility to pre-format, e.g. supply wikilink form for project picks). (b) options_source — prompt-level field on type:"select" prompts; currently supports options_source:"all_projects" which resolves at prompt-render time to ["(none)", ...all type:project notes by file.name] via dv.pages().where(p => p.type === "project").map(p => p.file.name). The select picker's answer is post-processed: "(none)" or empty → ""; any project name → wikilink "[[<name>]]". Preset values bypass this post-process (helper supplies its own formatted answer). Spec-mutation safety: _loadSpec re-reads the registry JSON on each invocation, so per-call p.options mutation is safe. v0.6.0 MINOR (v0.105.0 S1): four additive capabilities, all backward-compatible. (a) Issue 1 fix — create() opens the just-created TFile via workspace.getLeaf(false).openFile(newFile) rather than openLinkText(targetPath, ""). openLinkText routes through the link resolver, which can race against metadata-cache lag immediately after vault.create() and create a NEW empty `<name> 1.md` (auto-numbered) instead of opening the file just written. TFile-based open bypasses the resolver. (b) NEW options_source "current_project_sections" — resolves to the section[] labels of the project that owns the current file. If current_file.type === "project", reads its own sections[]; otherwise reads sections[] off the project note at spice/projects/<current.project_slug>/. Returns plain string labels (wikilink wrap stripped). (c) NEW options_source "current_section_sub_sections" — resolves to the sub-section labels (depth-2 section-hub notes) under the current file's folder. Only emits non-empty when current file is a depth-1 section-hub; otherwise []. (d) Skip-prompt-when-empty — when an options_source resolves to [] AND the prompt is required: false, the prompt UI is skipped entirely and ctx.prompts[p.key] set to "". Avoids the empty-<select> UX pitfall (Issue 4 requirement: never show an empty picker). Post-process: the two new sources yield plain string values (no wikilink wrap) — destination folder templates + frontmatter scalars consume them as filepath segments / bare strings.
